Subject: Clearwave trial onboarding checklist + exec readout request

Samir / Emily — thanks again for the call today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Recap (30-min discovery)
- Primary goal: improve triage throughput for intake forms and reduce manual tagging latency across 6 clinics.
- Success criteria (high level): 15% reduction in manual-review volume; 98% intent classification accuracy for top 5 intent classes; end-to-end median latency < 300ms for inference on submit.
- Stakeholders: Samir (Clinical Ops), Emily (Platform), Vanessa (AE, Redwood), Connor (Solutions), Marissa (CS).

Proposed POC / trial plan (first draft)
1) Scope: 6 clinics (ingest from form API; out-of-band training data allowed).
2) Duration: 4 weeks of live evaluation after onboarding (2 weeks integration/setup).
3) Success metrics: detailed below.
4) Ownership: Redwood will provide model + endpoint, monitoring dashboard, and a QA prompt set; Clearwave owns dataset access and internal test cases.

Immediate next steps (please confirm):
- I will send a POC plan doc and a one-sheet checklist with owners (attached).
- Can we lock a potential exec readout window during week of Jul 26 (preferred: Jul 28 morning PT) for go/no-go? That will be the final decision slot after the 4-week trial.
- Please send the contact for your infra lead for network permits (if different from Emily).

Attachments: Clearwave_POCTestPlan_v1.docx (POC plan), POC-checklist.xlsx (owners & milestones), redwood-security-snip.pdf (security summary)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with dates for an integration kickoff once we confirm owners.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Clarifications / asks:
- The success metrics look right; can you add an evaluation plan that shows how we will measure the 15% reduction (sampling cadence, baseline window, and who validates)?
- We will need a short list of required fields from our form API and a sample payload so engineering can scope mapping. Emily, could you send that sample by EOD?
- Exec readout: Jul 28 morning PT works for Samir and Emily, but our CPO prefers afternoons; would you be able to offer a backup slot on Jul 29 afternoon PT?

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@clearwavehealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearwave trial onboarding checklist + exec readout request

Samir — thanks, answers inline and attached a slightly expanded POC plan (Clearwave_POCTestPlan_v1.docx). Highlights below.

Evaluation plan (summary)
- Baseline window: sample two weeks of recent form traffic (Redwood to receive anonymized sample set from Clearwave).
- Measurement cadence: weekly checkpoints during the 4-week trial; final readout will compare week-4 to baseline.
- Validation: Clearwave QA (Emily’s team) will review a stratified sample (1,000 submissions or full set if under 1k) against the classification labels. Redwood will provide tooling to export labeled candidates for review.

Success criteria (concrete):
- Manual-review volume reduction: >= 15% fewer items requiring human correction across test set vs baseline.
- Classification accuracy: >= 98% top-1 accuracy on the 5 primary intents (billing, intake-error, referral, appointment-change, insurance-query).
- Latency: median inference < 300ms measured at Redwood endpoint under trial load profile (we include measurement logs in dashboard).

Security / logs: Redwood masks PII by default in request logs (names, SSNs, unstructured notes) and retention for the POC is set to 30 days unless you request otherwise; details in redwood-security-snip.pdf. We can sign an Addendum if you need longer retention or different handling.

Integration checklist (owners & timeline)
- Week 0–1 (integration): network allowlist + sample payload (Emily) -> Redwood infra (Connor) -> endpoint smoke test.
- Week 2 (validation): ingest test traffic, weekly checkpoint #1.
- Weeks 3–6 (live evaluation): weekly checkpoints, final validation in week 6.
- Week 7 (readout): exec summary and go/no-go.

Owners
- Redwood: Vanessa (trial owner / exec readout), Connor (solutions lead / integration), Platform Eng on-call for infra.
- Clearwave: Samir (trial sponsor), Emily (engineering lead), QA lead (TBD).

Proposed readout windows (pick one):
- Option A: Wed, Jul 28, 2027 — 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred by Redwood)
- Option B: Thu, Jul 29, 2027 — 14:00–15:00 PT (backup for Clearwave CPO)

I’ve attached the POC doc and checklist (see attachments). If you can confirm owners and pick a readout slot, Connor and I will schedule an integration kickoff and block internal prep time.

Attachments: Clearwave_POCTestPlan_v1.docx, POC-checklist.xlsx, redwood-security-snip.pdf

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
